title: 授权状态漂移
scope: discussion, review and file execution transitions
summary: A previous authorization or an ambiguous continuation is treated as permission for a new file change.

title: 用户裁决被旧口径覆盖
summary: A current user decision is retained as a question or displaced by old pages, documents or relay claims.

title: 执行者声称替代本地验证
summary: An executor completion statement is accepted without local diff, command, DOM or screenshot evidence.

title: 无依据扩展业务事实
scope: fields, permissions, defaults, errors and cross-platform chains
summary: The executor invents field, permission, default, error or cross-platform behavior not owned by current evidence.

title: 需求说明污染真实页面
scope: page body, business modal and requirement drawer boundary
summary: Development, test or requirement narration leaks into user-visible page surfaces.

title: 需求按钮和文档数据源遗漏
scope: doc button, docId and script loading order
summary: A page or drawer change omits the requirement entry, docId or required document data source.

title: 源页面注册和迭代引用遗漏
scope: source page menu, month label, route and iteration strategy
summary: A source page is created or changed without a source directory entry, complete month label or declared iteration reference.

title: 历史快照读取活页或可变依赖
summary: A historical iteration references an evolving source page or an unfrozen documentation dependency.

title: dirty 工作区或暂存范围污染
summary: Existing changes are overwritten, reverted or committed together with the current task.

title: 页面可见改动没有真实证明
scope: visible page, modal and entry changes
summary: Syntax checks or static search are presented as proof that a user-visible change rendered and behaved correctly.

title: 上传和缓存交付闭环遗漏
scope: cache bust, dependent files and online delivery statement
summary: A local change is reported as online-effective without the required dependent upload and cache process.

title: 语义失败被自动修复掩盖
scope: recover, permissions, evidence conflict and scope ambiguity
summary: A requirement, permission, evidence or endpoint conflict is treated as a mechanical retry or code-only fix.

title: 瘦身导致近场约束丢失
scope: rule migration and weak-model run package
summary: Rules are removed or split by token pressure before weaker models demonstrate equivalent behavior on the same fixture.

title: Memory 候选越权为事实或规则
scope: Memory event, pattern and rule admission
summary: An event, pattern, local observation or executor claim is injected as a user decision, business fact or active rule.

title: 跨模型准入外推
scope: provider, adapter, epoch and task-level qualification
summary: A result from one model, host, tool set or permission tier is treated as proof that another model can perform the same task.

title: 批次审批依赖后续批次产物
scope: batch dependency graph and approval gates
summary: An earlier batch cannot be approved until a later dependent batch has produced runtime identities or eligibility.

title: 验证债务只比较总数或完整输出
summary: A removed failure and a new failure can cancel out in totals while the comparator reports no new debt.

title: 来源 hash 只校验格式不校验内容
summary: A syntactically valid stale hash or member count passes without recomputing filesystem content.
